data.name: Areesa
data.gender_notes: Areesa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A feeling of happiness and satisfaction, a state of inner peace and joy. The name Areesa carries the meaning “Contentment, joy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Areesa usually hope their child will grow to embody contentment, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the inner joy and happiness that comes from a deep connection with Allah.
data.etymology: Areesa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Contentment, joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Areesa total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: أريسا
in_arabic.meaning: اسم أريسا يرمز إلى العلياء والارتفاع
in_arabic.long_meaning: أصل اسم أريسا من اللاتينية، يرمز إلى العلياء والارتفاع، وربما تم استخدامه في بعض الأماكن الإسلامية لوصف الشخصيات المتميزة، وقد تم تسجيله في بعض الكتب الإسلامية للعلماء والفلكيين، وفي بعض السياقات الإسلامية، يرمز اسم أريسا إلى الشجاعة والبسالة، وهو اسم نادر ومميز، ولكن في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية، يعتبر اسم أريسا كاسم غير مسموح أو غير مستخدم.

in_urdu.name: أريسا
in_urdu.meaning: اسم اریسا ہے جو بلند اور بلندوں کو ظاہر کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسم اریسا کا ماخذ لاطینی ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بلند اور بلندوں کو ظاہر کرنا، بعض اسلامی ذرائع ابلاغ میں اس کو ممتاز اور بلندوں کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، بعض اسلامی علماء اور فلاسفہ کے ناموں میں بھی اس کا استعمال کیا گیا ہے، ان کچھ معاملات میں اس کا مطلب شجاعت اور بہادری کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے، لیکن کچھ اسلامی ثقافتوں میں یہ نام غیر مسوول یا ممنوع خیال کیا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम आरीसा का मूल लैटिन भाषा से है, जिसका अर्थ है ऊंचा और ऊंचाइयों को दर्शाना, कुछ इस्लामी स्रोतों में इसे मेधावी और ऊंचाइयों के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है, कुछ इस्लामी विद्वानों और दर्शनवेत्ताओं के नामों में भी इसका उपयोग किया गया है, कुछ मामलों में इसका अर्थ शौर्य और बहादुरी के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है, लेकिन कुछ इस्लामी संस्कृतियों में यह नाम अस्वीकार्य या प्रतिबंधित माना जाता है

data.cultural_impact: The Arabic name "Areesa" is not widely recognized or used in mainstream Arab or Islamic culture. Its meaning, which centers around a sense of happiness, satisfaction, and inner peace, is not distinctive or unique to any particular culture or history within Islam. However, the concept of happiness and inner peace is a shared value and aspiration across various cultures and traditions within the Islamic world. The absence of a distinct attribution to a particular historical or cultural context allows the name to be embraced by individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the pursuit of inner peace, happiness, and contentment is considered an essential component of a spiritual life. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "Whoever feels at ease in his heart before Allah and puts his trust in Allah, then Allah will assure him with a tranquility he has not given to anyone else" (Bukhari and Muslim). The name "Areesa" echoes this spiritual value of finding peace and contentment within, despite the challenges of life. It serves as a reminder to seek inner peace and happiness even in the most trying times.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Contentment, joy" symbolizes A feeling of happiness and satisfaction, a state of inner peace and joy.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Areesa serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of contentment, joy.
